dvdSpines: ImageGen original typographic interpretations; not scans. Cropped from four-strip sheet, rotated 90 degrees. No years.
gameSpines: Original SVG spine designs composed from locally sourced cover artwork, platform colors and typography; not retail scans. Generated by scripts/build-spines.mjs.
gameIcons: ImageGen five-panel era-specific original art: GBA pixel platformer, PSP gritty ancient arena, iOS graph-paper doodle, 3DS low-poly adventure, Switch pastel island.
caseDimensions: Approximate proportional packaging dimensions, not calibrated product replicas.
albumSpines: Original SVG spine designs composed from sourced album cover artwork, individual palettes and typography; not retail scans. No turntable or vinyl assets used.
spineSizing: Game SVG canvas lengths are computed from case height/spine thickness; album SVG canvases use a fixed 64:1067 display ratio. Artwork backgrounds extend/crop to the canvas, lettering is laid out without glyph stretching, and images render at intrinsic aspect ratio. Album thickness is stylized, not a measurement of a specific pressing.
